prototype_checks.what: Standby floor and weighted daily average current (power.md M1, M6)
prototype_checks.method: bench supply 3.0 V at TP1/TP2, cell removed; 60 s idle, then the 24 h use-pattern script with a real phone
prototype_checks.instrument: power profiler (Nordic PPK2 or Joulescope), ≥ 100 kHz sampling
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: standby ≤ 1.2 µA; daily average ≤ 14 µA (21.2 µA limit, REQ-002)

prototype_checks.what: Charge per slow advertising event and per connection event (M2, M3)
prototype_checks.method: 3.0 V source, 0 dBm, 31-byte payload, 100 events averaged; 1000 ms connection, empty packets
prototype_checks.instrument: power profiler (Nordic PPK2 or Joulescope), ≥ 100 kHz sampling
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: ≤ 12 µC per advertising event (else 2000 ms interval); ≤ 4.5 µC per connection event

prototype_checks.what: Ring current in 2× and 3× and the adaptive ring rule (M4, D-028)
prototype_checks.method: source 3.0 V and 2.5 V; ring command from the app; log PZ_EN1/PZ_EN2 and VBAT
prototype_checks.instrument: power profiler (Nordic PPK2 or Joulescope), ≥ 100 kHz sampling + logic analyzer
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: 3× ≤ 15.5 mA, 2× ≤ 7.5 mA; firmware selects 2× at 2.5 V under load and 3× at 3.0 V

prototype_checks.method: assembled unit hanging free, mic at 25 cm on axis, 4 kHz ring, fresh cell and a cell at 2.4 V under load
prototype_checks.instrument: class 2 sound level meter, A-weighted, IEC 61672
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: ≥ 75 dB(A) in 3× on a fresh cell; ≥ 65 dB(A) in 2× at 2.4 V loaded

prototype_checks.what: Antenna match and harmonic filter tuning (D-020, D-030)
prototype_checks.method: assembled unit with cell and closed enclosure; S11 at the RF_P reference plane via a semi-rigid pigtail; tune C11/L2/C12, R2/C18; then conducted harmonics
prototype_checks.instrument: VNA 2–6 GHz (e.g. NanoVNA V2 or lab VNA) + spectrum analyzer
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: S11 ≤ −10 dB across 2402–2480 MHz; 2nd and 3rd harmonics ≥ 6 dB below the FCC 15.209 / EN 300 328 limits in the pre-scan

prototype_checks.what: 48 MHz frequency offset with C16/C17 fitted (D-019)
prototype_checks.method: CW tone at 2440 MHz from the TI test firmware, 25 °C and −10 °C
prototype_checks.instrument: spectrum analyzer or frequency counter, ≤ 1 ppm resolution
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: offset within ±20 ppm at both temperatures (BLE ±50 ppm budget with margin); else change C16/C17

prototype_checks.what: 32.768 kHz start-up at cold with ESR 90 kΩ (D-025, F-105)
prototype_checks.method: 10 power cycles at −10 °C; measure LFXT start time and sleep-clock accuracy
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: starts every time within 1 s; accuracy ≤ ±50 ppm

prototype_checks.what: Loaded cell voltage at cold and brown-out margin (M7, M8)
prototype_checks.method: CR2032 discharged to 50 % (15 kΩ for 680 h), −10 °C chamber, 2× ring; fast advertising through 1 kΩ from 2.7 V
prototype_checks.instrument: power profiler (Nordic PPK2 or Joulescope), ≥ 100 kHz sampling in ammeter mode + climate chamber
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: VBAT ≥ 2.3 V during the ring; VBAT ≥ 2.0 V and no reset over 30 s

prototype_checks.method: phone app RSSI and connection at 5 m and 10 m indoor, unit inside a fabric bag with keys
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: connected at 10 m indoor (≥ 5 m limit)

prototype_checks.what: Sound port alignment over the LS1 top port (Q-CD-01)
prototype_checks.method: view the assembled front shell hole against LS1 under a stereo microscope; then V-004
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: port centre within 0.3 mm of the Ø1.0 shell hole centre

prototype_checks.what: CR2032 insertion and removal through the Ø22.0 door bore (Q-CD-06)
prototype_checks.method: 10 insert/remove cycles with fingers only, door open; check the 3034 retainer after cycling
prototype_checks.instrument: visual check, 4-wire milliohm meter on cell contacts
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: cell seats without tools; contact resistance ≤ 100 mΩ after 10 cycles; no retainer deformation

prototype_checks.method: bare assembled board, probe SW1 pads 1-1 and 2-2 unpressed, then 1-2 pressed
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: 1-1 and 2-2 < 1 Ω unpressed; 1-2 < 1 Ω pressed and open when released

prototype_checks.what: Ingress seal of the door and port gaskets (REQ IP67 target)
prototype_checks.method: assembled EVT unit (machined or molded parts; SLA parts only for a pre-check), immersion 1 m for 30 min per IEC 60529 IPX7, then open and inspect
prototype_checks.instrument: immersion tank, moisture indicator paper inside
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: no water inside, indicator unchanged, unit still advertises

prototype_checks.method: door closed with both screws at 0.08 N·m; apply the UL 4200A abuse sequence on 3 units (drop, crush, torque on the door)
prototype_checks.instrument: torque driver, drop rig 1 m, force gauge
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: door stays secured and the cell stays inaccessible on all 3 units

prototype_checks.what: Button press force through the TPU membrane
prototype_checks.method: press the button cap centre at 1 mm/s, 10 presses
prototype_checks.pass_criteria: 2.3–3.3 N actuation force, tactile click felt, no pre-press at rest

findings.title: LS1 Murata PKMCS0909E4000-R1 is Last Time Buy with 0 stock at DigiKey

findings.title: Y1, BT1, L2, C13/C14 cannot be ordered at the chosen assembler in build quantity
findings.fix: Y1 → ABM11W-48.0000MHZ-7-B1U-T3; BT1 → Keystone 3034TR; L2 → LQG15HS family; C13/C14 → C1547 (D-018 to D-020, D-025)

findings.title: U1 VDDD (pin 16, internal 1.28 V regulator) has no decoupling capacitor
findings.evidence: [verified: SWRS272F Table 6-10; TI SWRC397 C9 1 µF, F-502]
findings.fix: Add C19 1 µF X5R 0402 at pin 16 (D-031)

findings.title: RF path has no harmonic low-pass filter: the stage-2 pi match was the only network
findings.evidence: [verified: TI SWRC397 C33-L33-C34 filter before the antenna match, F-502]
findings.fix: C11/L2/C12 = TI filter start values 1.5 pF / 2.7 nH / 1.5 pF; R2 + C18 form the antenna match (D-030)

findings.title: Only 2 of 3 VDDS pins decoupled, VDDR pins without 100 nF, RSTN without pull-up and capacitor
findings.fix: One 100 nF per VDDS and VDDR pin (C5, C6, C21, C22, C23); R3 100 kΩ + C20 100 nF on RSTN (D-031)

findings.title: VBAT bulk margin 1.39× against the CC2340 VDDS falling-slew limit at ring start
findings.evidence: [estimate: F-301, F-302 from Samsung DC-bias curves; verified limit: F-303]
findings.fix: Add C15 22 µF; the slew rule (14.2 µF) governs over the SWRA349 pulse method (6.7 µF) (D-022)

findings.title: 3× ring pulls a cold, 80 %-used CR2032 to about 1.0 V (reset)
findings.fix: Adaptive ring rule: start 2×, 3× only at VBAT ≥ 2.7 V under load, 1× + low-battery report below 2.3 V (D-028, architecture.md §4)
